verdict.rationale: Polar's own docs show a `polar listen` command for forwarding webhooks to a local server, which points to a first-party CLI. The only evidence is that single command, with no installation, authentication or broader resource-management coverage, and nothing showing agent-oriented use. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI documentation (install, auth, command reference), CLI coverage of core resources (products, customers, subscriptions), AI/agent-oriented CLI workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
